description: This file contains helper methods for creating comments within integration tests of the Conduit application. Specifically, it defines a static method to create an article comment, handling user creation if needed, and retrieving the resulting comment from the database.

classes.name: CommentHelpers
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to facilitate comment creation and retrieval during integration testing of the Conduit application.

methods.name: CreateComment
methods.description: Creates a comment for an article, optionally creating a default user if no username is provided; retrieves and returns the created comment from the database.
